blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Danao City is looking to expand its tourism industry through new destination developments, stronger community partnerships, and efforts to preserve its cultural heritage. These initiatives were highlighted at the Danao City Tourism Summit and Expo 2026 on Tuesday, Oct. 27. The summit brought together local government officials, barangay leaders, tourism stakeholders, local artisans, community partners, and tourism management students under the theme “Experience Danao: Here and Now.” It was organized by the Danao City Tourism and Development Office.
